text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: paging-integration error spike detected for eu-prod (pagerbridge). 503s on outgoing webhooks, escalation suppressed. auto-retries failing.

jamie: seeing the same. suppression flag tripped in notify-suppressor service? channel shows multiple suppressed pages. Is this just eu?

sara: confirmed, only eu-prod region is showing 503s to pager vendor. quick curl to the webhook proxy returns 503: 
```
$ curl -i https://eu-pager-proxy.prod.internal/notify -d '{"test":true}'
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 12:25:10 GMT
Connection: close
```

matt: logs from pagerbridge show connection resets to vendor from worker-2: 
```
2026-03-01T12:24:58Z pagerbridge[e2]: WARN outbound: connect error: handshake reset by peer (vendor gw)
2026-03-01T12:25:05Z pagerbridge[e2]: ERROR delivery: attempt=1 id=gid-abc123 status=503 body="Upstream service unavailable"
```

jamie: ok i'm going to try a quick restart of pagerbridge worker-2 in eu (rolling, drain first). will update in ~30s.

sara: if restart doesn't clear, we should flip suppressor to allow manual pages and enable sms-relay fallback for affected schedules.

jamie: initiating drain -> restart now. 

jamie: restart done, reconnected, running health check: 
```
$ kubectl -n infra exec pagerbridge-eu-2 -- curl -fsS localhost:8080/health || echo fail
ok
```

incident-bot: Update: pagerbridge (eu/worker-2) restarted by jamie. outbound 503s falling back; suppressed count decreasing.

sophia: customer-impact check: can we get how many pages were suppressed/dropped during spike? need numbers for CSMs.

jamie: looks like approx 9 suppressed pages between 12:22:30–12:26:00. manual retries from services queued ~7; 3 end-customer integrations reported missing deliveries (ticketed). oncall team "platform-sre-eu" missed 2 pages.

matt: metric snapshot: pagerbridge outbound_503_rate spiked to 18/min at peak, error budget alarms not triggered yet but retries caused queue backlog. link: https://grafana.internal/d/pagerbridge?orgId=1&panelId=4 (short link)

sara: mitigation checklist I'm doing now:
- adjust notify-suppressor threshold to avoid aggressive squelch during upstream flaps
- enable sms-relay fallback for affected schedules (temp)
- add short-term alert to notify ops if suppressed_count > 5 in 5m

sara: CLI to flip suppressor to relaxed mode: 
```bash
$ infractl suppressor update --env eu --threshold 10 --window 300
# then reload: infractl suppressor reload --env eu
```

jamie: please coordinate with support to reach out to the 3 affected customers, CSMs cc'd. i'll create an incident ticket and assign the postmortem.

sophia: noted. I'll draft a short customer note and flag the impacted accounts.

matt: quick follow-up: I found that vendor gateway had an intermittent TLS handshake reset around the same time — raising them a support case and sharing logs.

oncall-rotation-bot: Current oncall: jamie (primary), sophia (backup). Estimated time spent: 18m.

jamie: next steps:
- sara to apply suppressor relaxation + enable sms fallback (in progress)
- matt to file vendor support case and attach logs (done: CASE-2026-031)
- sophia to coordinate CSM outreach and customer notes
- jamie to file incident ticket and schedule postmortem (will do)

sara: suppressor relaxed and sms-fallback enabled. monitoring for suppressed_count -> OK so far.

jamie: incident ticket created: INC-2026-466. assigning to platform-sre. please add any notes.

sophia: leaving a note for postmortem to check whether suppressor thresholds should be location-aware and whether we need automatic sms fallback earlier.

matt: putting a watch on grafana alert, will revert suppressor settings once vendor confirms stability.

jamie: thanks all. closing live mitigation. please add any follow-ups to INC-2026-466. :thumbsup:
